rules.logic: BIOC("ITDR-017 Certificate Issued With Requester-Subject SAN Mismatch") AND ABIOC("ITDR-017 ESC1 Issuance-To-PKINIT Privileged Impersonation Chain") joined on the impersonated principal (the subject_alt_name_upn of the 4887 issuance equals the target_user_name authenticating via PKINIT in the 4768 TGT request) within 600 seconds. The lineage is rooted on the requesting domain identity: the LDAP template reconnaissance BIOC("ITDR-017 AD CS Certificate-Template LDAP Reconnaissance") and the enrollee-supplied-SAN request BIOC("ITDR-017 ESC1 Certificate Request With Enrollee-Supplied SAN") share the requester_domain_user that precedes the issuance, and an optional shadow-credential write BIOC("ITDR-017 Shadow-Credential Write To msDS-KeyCredentialLink") on the same identity extends the persistence. Fuses recon -> ESC1 SAN-mismatch issuance -> PKINIT privileged authentication -> optional shadow credential into a single ITDR credential-access / privilege-escalation incident, evidencing the AD CS ESC1 storyline end to end with citable certificate serials, template names, the impersonated UPN, and the exact Windows Security event records.
rules.name: ITDR-017 AD CS ESC1 SAN-Mismatch To Privileged PKINIT Chain Stitch
